distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) reported 黑龙江（带岭），辽宁（昭乌达盟）. 黄复生等 (2015) reported 黑龙江，辽宁. These are literature-based occurrence reports; Mainland China remains Candidate pending occurrence review.

host_note: Host names are retained as published, with a citation for each reported association. Where both 1984 and 2015 list the same host, the records should not be assumed to represent independent confirmations. Host associations have not undergone independent review.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Carphoborus teplouchovi Spessivtsev, 1916.
